## 简体中文

- 多用户订阅服务采用独立管理界面，并与本地控制台共享订阅配置编辑器；支持自定义节点、访问统计与只读共享订阅。
- 订阅调试显示实时阶段、源恢复信息和配置转换诊断，改进订阅抓取与发布产物回退行为。
- 新增分层网络诊断，逐步展示 DNS、路由、TCP、TLS 与 HTTP 检查及问题处理建议。
- 改进 Windows 运行时恢复，并自动避让冲突的 FakeIP 路由；在线更新优先使用运行中的托管代理。
- 修复 OpenWrt 入站 DNS 处理与规则下载地址，提供带版本的 OpenWrt 导出路径；支持选择私有地址和中国地址分组，恢复各客户端与导出配置中的可读直连名称。
- 改进管理界面的表格、代码面板、操作提示和订阅筛选标签编辑体验；移除 Web 控制台中的 UI 卸载入口。

## English

- The multi-user subscription service now has an independent management interface and shares its subscription configuration editor with the local control UI, including custom nodes, access statistics, and read-only shared subscriptions.
- Subscription debugging shows live stages, source recovery information, and configuration conversion diagnostics, with improved fetching and published-artifact fallback behavior.
- Added layered network diagnostics with progressive DNS, routing, TCP, TLS, and HTTP checks and actionable recommendations.
- Improved Windows runtime recovery and automatic avoidance of conflicting FakeIP routes. Online updates prefer the running managed proxy.
- Fixed OpenWrt inbound DNS handling and rule download URLs, added versioned OpenWrt export paths and selectable private and China address groups, and restored readable direct names across clients and exported configurations.
- Improved management tables, code panels, action feedback, and subscription filter tag editing, and removed the UI uninstall action from the Web console.
